patch_list: Disable ad and promo remote config
Blackholes ad/paywall/reward feature-flag keys and remote promo payload keys so the app cannot enable ad or upsell surfaces from remote config.
Disables bundled ad mediation components and removes ad identifier/ad services permissions.
Disable Expo updates and backup restore
Forces the app to use the bundled local Hermes asset instead of cached Expo OTA updates or restored app data.
Experimental Hermes bytecode edit: makes ad-card components return null. May prevent startup; opt in only for testing.
Neutralize bundled ad unit IDs and premium banners
Replaces bundled ad unit IDs and premium/reward banner copy in the Hermes bundle with same-length non-serving/blank values while leaving the AdMob app ID intact.
Force-removes the remaining premium/reward banner strings from the bundled Hermes asset.
Neutralizes Expo OTA update configuration in the bundled Expo config so the APK prefers local bundled assets.
